description: This file declares functions and interfaces for capturing and manipulating stack traces, including retrieving stack frames, handling context from signal handlers, and setting custom unwinding functions. It is part of the Abseil debugging library.

methods.name: GetStackFrames
methods.description: Records program counter values for up to max_depth frames, skipping skip_count frames, and stores results and sizes in provided buffers.

methods.name: GetStackFramesWithContext
methods.description: Records program counter values from a signal handler context, with options for dropped frames and context pointer.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Records program counter values for up to max_depth frames, skipping skip_count frames, returning only the addresses.

methods.name: GetStackTraceWithContext
methods.description: Records program counter values from a signal handler context, with options for dropped frames.

methods.name: SetStackUnwinder
methods.description: Sets a custom function for unwinding stack frames, replacing the default unwinder.

methods.name: DefaultStackUnwinder
methods.description: Default implementation for unwinding stack frames, used if no custom unwinder is set.
